info.title: Lightspeed eCom REST API responses read by wp-woo-idempotent-importer
info.description: Lightspeed eCom (C-Series) publishes no OpenAPI document. This subset is transcribed by hand from the example responses and property lists of each endpoint page of the official reference at https://developers.lightspeedhq.com/ecom/endpoints/ (fetched 2026-10-16; each schema and operation cites its page): only the responses the Lightspeed adapter reads, with every property those pages show for them. Paths are relative to `<cluster>/<language>` (e.g. https://api.webshopapp.com/en). Types follow the examples where the property lists give none; fields the examples send as `false` when unset (images, links, a customer's gender or birth date) allow it. Required properties are the identifiers and the fields the adapter cannot do without.

Link.description: A link to another resource ({"resource": {"id", "url", "link"}}), as every endpoint page shows them; `id` is false for a link to a list.

LinkOrFalse.description: A link, or false when nothing is linked (every endpoint page).

ImageOrFalse.description: An image, or false when none is set (category, product, variant, brand and blog article pages).

DiscountProduct.description: A product a discount is limited to, sent whole (Transcribed from https://developers.lightspeedhq.com/ecom/endpoints/discount/; its other properties are the Product's).

DiscountCategory.description: A category a discount is limited to, sent whole (Transcribed from https://developers.lightspeedhq.com/ecom/endpoints/discount/; its other properties are the Category's).
